summary: Bilateral lower lung and perihilar opacities are increased, greatest at the right base.

findings.rationale: After matching the diaphragms and hila, the current film shows broader denser bilateral basilar and perihilar hazy opacities than the prior, with the most conspicuous increase at the right lower lung. Low-volume technique persists on both exams, but the interval bilateral worsening is larger than technical variation alone.
